examInfo.subject: 英文
examInfo.group: 大學組第一、二、三、四類組
examInfo.title: 114學年度身心障礙學生升學大專校院甄試 英文

questions.text: The victory in the 2024 international baseball game does not represent the success of one individual but rather a ______ effort of the whole team.
steps: 「joint effort」意為「共同努力」，符合「整個團隊的努力」的語境。

questions.text: You should ______ this button back on your shirt right away before you lose it.
steps: 「sew a button」（縫鈕釦）是固定搭配，指把鈕釦縫回衣服上。

questions.text: You should come to the party tonight; it is a good chance to ______ with colleagues from other departments.
steps: 「network with someone」意為「與人建立人脈、交流拓展關係」，符合與其他部門同事互動的語境。

questions.text: The employee solved the problem, but her boss took all the ______.
steps: 「take credit」意為「把功勞攬為己有」，符合上司搶走部屬功勞的語境。

questions.text: Customers are required by the restaurant to pay a ______ of NT$1,000 when they make the reservation.
steps: 「deposit」意為「訂金、押金」，符合訂位時須先支付一筆款項的語境。

questions.text: The mayor's phone has been ringing ______ since the news about the scandal was released this morning.
steps: 「ringing constantly」意為「持續不斷地響」，符合電話從早上開始不停響的語境。

questions.text: The survivors were in ______ need of medical help as many of them had been seriously injured in the air crash.
steps: 「urgent need」意為「急迫的需求」，符合空難重傷倖存者急需醫療協助的語境。

questions.text: The host of the talk show has received many complaints from the audience as one of the guest speakers made some really ______ statements in the show.
steps: 「objectionable」意為「令人反感、招致反對的」，符合來賓發言引起觀眾大量投訴抱怨的語境。

questions.text: Please put that ______ of books in the recycle bin after you clean off the shelf.
steps: 「a stack of books」意為「一疊書」，是常見搭配用語。

questions.text: The missing child's family is desperately seeking any possible information about his activities or ______.
steps: 「whereabouts」意為「下落、行蹤」，符合家屬急欲得知失蹤孩童行蹤的語境。

questions.text:
【11-15題組｜冷沙漠】文章大意：冷沙漠（溫帶沙漠）終年寒冷乾燥，動植物發展出特殊適應方式。
＿＿(11)＿＿ the lack of air moisture, they experience dry weather and very little rain or snow.
steps: 「Owing to」意為「由於、因為」，表因果關係，符合「因空氣濕度不足，故經歷乾燥氣候」的語意邏輯。

questions.text: 【11-15題組】Most animals living in cold deserts have developed adaptations to ＿＿(12)＿＿ the falling temperatures.
steps: 「cope with」意為「應付、因應」，符合動物演化出適應機制以「應付」低溫的語境。

questions.text: 【11-15題組】Bactrian camels ＿＿(13)＿＿ in the Gobi desert have thick and hairy coats to keep them warm during the cold winters.
steps: 此處為過去分詞作後位修飾語（省略關係代名詞及be動詞的化簡關係子句），意即「被發現於戈壁沙漠的雙峰駱駝」，故用過去分詞found。

questions.text: 【11-15題組】The accumulation and ＿＿(14)＿＿ of snow changes the landscapes of cold deserts drastically.
steps: 「accumulation and melting」（積雪與融雪）是一組相對的自然過程，兩者共同劇烈改變地貌景觀，語意通順。

questions.text: 【11-15題組】Many cold desert animals change their color to match their changing ＿＿(15)＿＿ so as to protect themselves from being seen and preyed upon.
steps: 「surroundings」意為「周遭環境」，符合動物改變體色以配合環境變化、避免被天敵發現的語境。

questions.text:
【16-20題組｜黑色星期五】文章大意：感恩節隔天「黑色星期五」成為美國最熱鬧的購物日，文章探討此名稱的由來。
Every year, millions of shoppers visit websites and ＿＿(16)＿＿ stores on that day, seeking the best deals of the season.
steps: 「flood into」意為「湧入」，符合大批購物者湧入實體店面搶購優惠的語境。

questions.text: 【16-20題組】police officers in Philadelphia began using "Black Friday" ＿＿(17)＿＿ the disorder that resulted on that day.
steps: 「使用……來描述……」為不定詞表目的的用法：begin using X to describe Y，故填不定詞to describe。

questions.text: 【16-20題組】The huge crowds created a headache for the police, who worked longer ＿＿(18)＿＿ than usual.
steps: 「work longer shifts」意為「輪值更長的班次」，符合警察因應人潮需超時輪班工作的語境。

questions.text: 【16-20題組】＿＿(19)＿＿, many look at this name through an accounting lens.
steps: 前段是警方角度的命名由來解釋，此處以「However」（然而）轉折，引出另一種從會計角度出發的不同解釋。

questions.text: 【16-20題組】red ink indicated a loss and black ＿＿(20)＿＿ a profit.
steps: 此句與前半部「red ink indicated a loss」為對稱平行結構，「demonstrated」（顯示、表明）與「indicated」意義相近，符合對稱語意「黑色墨水則顯示獲利」。

questions.text:
【21-25題組｜關島棕樹蛇】文章大意：棕樹蛇入侵關島造成鳥類滅絕與蜘蛛數量暴增，生態嚴重失衡。
What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: The invasion of snakes has caused the ecosystem of Guam to be out of balance.
options.B: The birds on Guam are dying out because of the introduction of snakes.
options.C: The population of spiders is exploding on Guam due to the absence of birds.
options.D: The unpredictable weather system has turned Guam into a hellish island.

steps: 全文涵蓋蛇入侵導致鳥類滅絕、進而造成蜘蛛數量暴增等一連串生態連鎖反應，主旨應是「蛇的入侵造成關島生態系失衡」這個較全面的概念，(A)最為適當，其餘選項僅涵蓋文章的部分內容（單獨鳥類滅絕或蜘蛛暴增），並非完整主旨；(D)則與文章內容（生態入侵，非天氣）無關。
questions.final: 答案：(A) The invasion of snakes has caused the ecosystem of Guam to be out of balance.

questions.text: 【21-25題組】What does "one" in Paragraph Two refer to?
steps: 第二段提及蛇「emptying the jungle of every single one」，呼應第一段提到的原生鳥類（native birds），且後文接著說「12種鳥類中10種已滅絕」，故「one」指的是「鳥（bird）」。

questions.text: 【21-25題組】Which of the following is closest in meaning to "Guam's spider population may once have been unremarkable" in Paragraph Four?

options.A: There may have been few spiders on Guam before.
options.B: The spider's webs on Guam were not remarkably beautiful before.
options.C: The number of spiders used to be smaller than the population of Guam.
options.D: There may have been more spiders on Guam than on the nearby islands.

steps: 「unremarkable」意為「不特別顯眼、不出眾」，套用於蜘蛛族群數量，意指當時蜘蛛數量並不特別多、不引人注目，最接近選項(A)「以前可能蜘蛛數量很少」的說法。
questions.final: 答案：(A) There may have been few spiders on Guam before.

questions.text: 【21-25題組】Which of the following is most likely the major organizational structure of the passage?
steps: 全文以「蛇的入侵」為起因，依序說明其導致鳥類滅絕、蜘蛛暴增等一連串「結果」，屬於典型的「因果關係」（cause-effect）文章組織架構。

questions.text: 【21-25題組】According to the passage, which of the following statements is true?

options.A: Wildlife scientists managed to correct the mistakes made by human.
options.B: Guam has 40 times more spiders than neighboring islands all year round.
options.C: Brown tree snakes were intentionally imported into Guam by merchants.
options.D: In the Bahamas, there are more spiders on islands without lizards.

steps: 文中明確提及巴哈馬的研究發現「沒有蜥蜴（其天敵）的島嶼上蜘蛛數量約多10倍」，符合(D)敘述。(A)錯誤：文末說明「入侵者正在獲勝」，人類尚未成功糾正此生態問題。(B)錯誤：文中限定「雨季期間」蜘蛛數量為鄰近島嶼的40倍，並非「全年」皆是如此。(C)錯誤：文中說明棕樹蛇是「意外（accidentally）」隨貨船引入，並非商人「刻意」引進。
questions.final: 答案：(D) In the Bahamas, there are more spiders on islands without lizards.
